    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",

- The registrant (Pinnacle Entertainment, Inc., CIK 1656239, NASDAQ: PNK) filed annual
  reports on Form 10-K for fiscal 2016 (filed 2017-02-28) and fiscal 2017 (filed 2018-03-01);
  these are its only two annual reports as an independent public filer. [SRC: SEC accession 0001656239-17-000016, Form 10-K] [SRC: SEC accession 0001656239-18-000022, Form 10-K]
- The registrant's common stock was removed from listing/registration on its exchange via a
  Form 25-NSE filed 2018-10-15. [SRC: SEC accession 0001354457-18-000410, Form 25-NSE]
- The registrant terminated its Exchange Act registration by Form 15-12B filed 2018-10-25,
  reporting the approximate number of holders of record of its common stock as "One (1)" —
  indicating the stock had come into single ownership. [SRC: SEC accession 0001656239-18-000058, Form 15-12B]
- Consequently no Form 10-K or other periodic report was filed by the registrant covering the
  later part of the fixed ~2018–2020 outcome window; there are no audited public financial
  statements for that period attributable to this registrant on a stand-alone basis. [SRC: SEC accession 0001656239-18-000058, Form 15-12B]

## Realized event within the outcome window (acquirer's primary disclosure)
- On October 15, 2018 Penn National Gaming, Inc. (NASDAQ: PENN) announced it "completed its
  previously announced acquisition of Pinnacle Entertainment, Inc. (PNK: Nasdaq) … as well as
  the related divestitures to Boyd Gaming Corporation … and the real estate transactions with
  Gaming and Leisure Properties, Inc." [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-18-061976, Penn National Gaming Form 8-K EX-99.1]
- Following the acquisition the acquirer stated it would operate "40 facilities in 18
  jurisdictions," "more than 49,000 gaming machines, 1,200 table games and nearly 9,000 hotel
  rooms," and "more than 30,000 team members," absorbing the acquired operations into its
  consolidated regional-gaming portfolio. [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-18-061976, Penn National Gaming Form 8-K EX-99.1]
- Press coverage corroborates the October 15, 2018 completion of the Penn National acquisition
  of Pinnacle. [SRC: https://www.gamingintelligence.com/finance/manda/41997-penn-national-gaming-completes-pinnacle-entertainment-acquisition/]

## Items noted but not primary-verifiable (uncertain)
- Because the registrant was acquired whole and deregistered at the onset of the fixed 3–5-year
  outcome window (~2.5 years after closing), no stand-alone public financial trajectory
  (net income/loss, impairment, divestiture, or comparable scalar) exists for the acquired
  operations across the full window, and the acquirer's post-acquisition filings consolidate
  the operations without separately disclosing their subsequent stand-alone trajectory; the
  deeper realized financial trajectory over the window is therefore coded **uncertain (no
  separate public record)**. [SRC: SEC accession 0001656239-18-000058, Form 15-12B]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- The single best-documented realized event in the fixed outcome window is that the registrant
  ceased to exist as an independent public company: it was acquired whole by Penn National
  Gaming on October 15, 2018, delisted (Form 25-NSE, 2018-10-15) and deregistered (Form 15-12B,
  2018-10-25, one holder of record), with its operations folded into the acquirer's
  consolidated portfolio; no separate public financial record documents the operations'
  trajectory across the remainder of the window, so that deeper trajectory is uncertain. [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-18-061976, Penn National Gaming Form 8-K EX-99.1] [SRC: SEC accession 0001656239-18-000058, Form 15-12B]

[SLICE END]
